text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel it... I feel it! A powerful 
sympathy, a destiny with the NHK Mile 
Cup!! I feel like I can pull off an 
excellent run today!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This race is merely the overture to the 
world. Watch closely from right there at 
my most fabulous performance...!
